aiOverview.text: Drink only boiled or purified water to prevent waterborne infections during the monsoon season. Drink purified water: Always boil or filter your drinking water, and carry a personal water bottle when you travel. Avoid street food: Steer clear of open-air snacks, raw salads, and pre-cut fruits that can easily carry bacteria. Eat fresh meals: Focus on hot, freshly cooked homemade food and wash all produce carefully. Wash hands often: Use soap and clean water before eating or preparing food. Stay dry: Change out of wet clothes, socks, and shoes immediately to avoid fungal skin infections. Avoid stagnant water: Do not walk barefoot through puddles or floodwaters to prevent infections like leptospirosis. Prevent mosquito bites: Use insect repellents and nets to guard against dengue and malaria breeding in standing water. Boost vitamin C: Eat citrus fruits and fresh vegetables to strengthen your immune system. Rest and exercise: Maintain light indoor workouts and aim for 7 to 8 hours of sleep nightly.
